info.title: LexScholarMCP
info.description: No-auth MCP server federating ten open-access LEGAL SCHOLARSHIP sources through a single endpoint: DOAJ (peer-review guaranteed), Law Review Commons (US law reviews, energy/oil-gas/arbitration subject sets), SciELO (Latin America, real full text), HAL (France), Dialnet (Spain, discovery only), DergiPark (Turkey), OpenAIRE (EU), Crossref + Unpaywall (DOI/open-copy resolution), OpenAlex (metered, gap jurisdictions). A deterministic router picks the 2-3 indexes that fit each question instead of querying all of them. Tools: search_legal_scholarship, compare_jurisdictions, get_scholarship_article, get_scholarship_fulltext, resolve_doi, list_sources. COMPARATIVE DOCTRINE source — peer-reviewed scholarship, NOT legislation or case law; never the final legal authority.

post.summary: Legal Scholarship MCP (10 sources, one endpoint)
post.description: Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint (JSON-RPC 2.0). Copilot Studio discovers the tools automatically on connect.
